svg.title: 公司有招聘系统。你，也该有求职系统。 — Job Search Harness
svg.desc: Job Search Harness. YOUR SEARCH. YOUR SYSTEM. Local first, open source, built for applicants. An editorial banner with cream typography and a lime eight-point star. All lettering is drawn as vector paths for reliable rendering.

g.aria-label: BUILT FOR THE OTHER SIDE OF HIRING.
